x-card.description: Datasets, tables and GoogleSQL queries with a cost limit. Changes wait for approval.

project.title: Project
project.description: The Google Cloud project that runs, and pays for, the queries.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the queries run, such as US, EU or europe-west1. Empty: BigQuery chooses from the tables.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: The datasets agents may use: dataset or project.dataset, * matching any characters. Empty: every dataset the credentials may read.

source.title: Authentication
source.description: Existing Google sign-in uses Application Default Credentials (ADC) on this computer, from gcloud auth application-default login. A service account key signs in as that service account.

impersonate.title: Service account to impersonate
impersonate.description: Recommended for stage and prod: calls borrow this service account's token for a few minutes. Grant it roles/bigquery.dataViewer on the datasets and roles/bigquery.jobUser on the project. Empty: calls use the sign-in or key itself.

delegates.title: Delegation chain
delegates.description: Service accounts that pass the impersonation along, in order, as the IAM API names them. Usually empty.

lifetimeSeconds.title: Token lifetime
lifetimeSeconds.description: How long a borrowed token of the service account to impersonate lasts.

quotaProject.title: Billed project
quotaProject.description: The project whose API quota the calls use (x-goog-user-project); needs serviceusage.services.use. Empty: the credentials' own. Query costs go to Project.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: The cost limit of one statement. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

maxMbBilled.title: Data per statement
maxMbBilled.description: The most bytes one statement may process (maximumBytesBilled). A dry run refuses a larger one before it runs.
